title: Fourier mass on a representing support
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be $\pm1$-valued, and let $p$ be a nonzero multilinear polynomial on the Boolean cube whose threshold sign, with zero assigned sign $1$, is $f$. If $F$ is a finite family of coordinate subsets containing every subset with nonzero coefficient in $p$, then $1\leq\sum_{S\in F}|\widehat f(S)|$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier–Walsh coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a finite family of coordinate subsets
Every subset with nonzero coefficient in $p$ belongs to $F$
The threshold sign of $p$, with zero assigned sign $1$, equals $f$
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$, and $p(x)=\sum_Sa_S\chi_S(x)$ be a nonzero real multilinear polynomial on $\{0,1\}^n$.
Suppose $f(x)=\operatorname{sgn}(p(x))$, with $\operatorname{sgn}(t)=1$ for $t\ge0$ and $-1$ for $t<0$, and let $F$ be a finite family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ satisfying $a_S\ne0\Rightarrow S\in F$.
Writing $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_x[f(x)\chi_S(x)]$ for uniform $x$, one has $1\le\sum_{S\in F}|\widehat f(S)|$.
